name: design_agent_system
description: Default tool for creating an agent system design. Runs the full pipeline (analyze → generate → evaluate → refine, up to 3 attempts) and returns the complete design, evaluation, and quality scores in a single response. Takes 5-10 minutes; emits progress notifications every 30 s so clients stay connected. Use this whenever the user wants an agent system design, including when they explicitly request design_agent_system. Do NOT use submit_agent_design_job for ordinary design requests — that tool is only for clients with short request timeouts (Cursor, Claude Desktop) and returns only a job_id.

arguments.name: requirements
arguments.desc: Agent system requirements description (1-100000 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Target agent domain (1-200 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: override_topology
arguments.desc: Override the derived agent topology

name: analyze_agent_system
description: Analyze requirements and derive agent system recommendations using pattern matching and domain similarity.

arguments.name: requirements
arguments.desc: Agent system requirements description (1-100000 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Target agent domain (1-200 chars, must contain visible text)

name: generate_agent_system
description: Generate an agent system design from requirements, topology, domain, and selected patterns.

arguments.name: requirements
arguments.desc: Agent system requirements description (1-100000 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: topology
arguments.desc: Agent topology to use (1-100000 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Target agent domain (1-200 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: selected_patterns
arguments.desc: Pattern names to incorporate in the agent system

name: evaluate_agent_system
description: Evaluate an agent system design against specified criteria and domain using pattern benchmarking.

arguments.name: agent_system
arguments.desc: Agent system design as dictionary

arguments.name: criteria
arguments.desc: Evaluation criteria description (1-100000 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Target agent domain (1-200 chars, must contain visible text)

name: list_agent_patterns
description: List all available agent patterns known to the server. Returns a minimal view with 'name' and 'description' for each pattern. Optional filters: 'category' (one of: reasoning, tool_use, planning, reflection, research_synthesis, multi_agent, memory, retrieval, safety_control, observability) and 'domain' (matches against pattern.suitable_domains).

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Optional category filter. Valid values: reasoning, tool_use, planning, reflection, research_synthesis, multi_agent, memory, retrieval, safety_control, observability. Unknown values return an empty list.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Optional domain filter. Matches against pattern.suitable_domains.

name: get_agent_pattern
description: Get the full JSON of a single agent pattern by its name (e.g. 'react', 'supervisor-worker', 'self-rag'). Returns the complete pattern object including context, benefits, tradeoffs, quality_attributes, suitable_domains, component_types, technology_stack, best_practices, and references. Raises an error if not found.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Pattern name, e.g. 'react', 'supervisor-worker', 'self-rag'

name: submit_agent_design_job
description: Start a background agent system design job and return a job_id immediately (returns in <100 ms; the job itself takes minutes). ONLY use this when the calling client cannot wait for a long response — e.g. Cursor, Claude Desktop, or any client with a 60-120 s request timeout. Do NOT use when the user wants the design itself or explicitly names a design tool — the blocking design_agent_system tool returns the full design directly. After starting, poll get_agent_design_status(job_id) every 10-30 s until status is 'completed', 'failed', or 'cancelled'.

arguments.name: requirements
arguments.desc: Agent system requirements description (1-100000 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Target agent domain (1-200 chars, must contain visible text)

arguments.name: override_topology
arguments.desc: Override the derived agent topology

name: get_agent_design_status
description: Poll the status of a submit_agent_design_job background job. Call repeatedly (every 10-30 s) until status is 'completed', 'failed', or 'cancelled'; when completed, the result field contains the full design output. Only use this with a job_id previously returned by submit_agent_design_job — do not use it to request a new design.

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: Job ID returned by submit_agent_design_job

name: cancel_agent_design
description: Cancel a running background agent system design job started via submit_agent_design_job. The background task checks the cancellation flag between pipeline stages and exits at the next stage boundary. Cancellation is best-effort and may take up to one LLM call to take effect. Only use with a job_id from submit_agent_design_job; jobs already completed, failed, or cancelled cannot be cancelled again.

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: Job ID returned by submit_agent_design_job

name: list_prompts
description:
List all available prompts.

Returns JSON with prompt metadata including name, description,
and optional arguments.

name: get_prompt
description:
Get a prompt by name with optional arguments.

Returns the rendered prompt as JSON with a messages array.
Arguments should be provided as a dict mapping argument names
to values.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: The name of the prompt to get

arguments.name: arguments
arguments.desc: Optional arguments for the prompt
